data.name: Kids Arcade
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Kids Arcade — the ultimate family-friendly local multiplayer party game! Gather your friends, grab your controllers, and dive into a vibrant collection of action-packed arcade challenges. Designed for 1 to 4 players in splitscreen, Kids Arcade combines classic gameplay loops with modern splitscreen visuals, lively animations, and responsive controls that players of all ages will love.

Whether you're playing solo to set high scores or gathering the family on the couch, Kids Arcade delivers non-stop thrills, laughs, and friendly competition!

🕹️ Four Exciting Games in One!

  • 🏃 Canyon Run (3D Splitscreen Runner)
    Strap in for a high-speed 3D dash! Race down a winding, dynamically generated canyon path. Dodge massive boulders, jump obstacles, and see who can survive the longest and cover the most distance!

  • 🐊 River Dash (Aquatic Obstacle Dodge)
    Take to the water! Control your otter as you swim through rushing rapids. Submerge beneath the surface to bypass floating logs, but watch out for snapping crocodiles waiting to catch you off guard!

  • 🐟 Fish Jump (Rapid Catching)
    Test your reflexes! Stand by the riverbank and catch jumping fish as they leap from the water. Timing is everything in this fast-paced reaction game.

  • 🐍 Danger Noodle (Multiplayer Snake Arena)
    A colorful, action-packed twist on the classic snake game! Navigate the sandy arena, gobble up eggs, and grow your snake with beautiful, rainbow-composite trail skins. Avoid colliding with walls and other players' tails to dominate the board!

🏆 Game Features

  • Couch Co-op & Splitscreen Action: Supports up to 4 players in vertical, horizontal, or a clean 2x2 splitscreen grid layout.

  • Tournament Mode: Compete across all four arcade games in a series to score points and crown the ultimate arcade champion!

  • Full Controller Support: Grab any gamepad or arcade stick! Jump, turn, navigate, and pause the action easily from your controller.

  • Global Ready: Fully translated into 30 languages with custom font layouts optimized for every locale!

  • Retro-Modern Visuals: Gorgeous colors, dynamic micro-animations, and full-screen pause/game over overlay menus.

Race through 3D canyons, outswim crocodiles, catch fish in mid air, and control giant snakes in the ultimate local party showdown! With full controller support.
